nurse.text: Hello, love! Welcome to the Dover Sanctuary, last stop before France. Let's have a look at your team.
What can we do for you?

then.text: On the counter with them. Sea air's very good for them, but so is a sit-down.
All done! Fit for the crossing, if you were going. Which you're not. They don't do Sanctuaries in Calais, I asked.
The Ark's over there. It's been to France twice. It didn't like the ferry.

else.text: Mind how you go. Keep back from the cliff edge, and away from the lorries.
